title: Hovering a month on the Revenue and technician charts lists its values
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with revenue and technician clocked time over the last twelve months, and at least two technicians in its Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Set the Revenue pill to Last 12 Months and click View details.
  3. Hover the bar of a month with sales (e.g. Jul 2026) and read the tooltip.
  4. Set the Technician Efficiency pill to Last 12 Months and click View details.
  5. Hover a month (e.g. Jun 2026) and read the tooltip.
  6. Count the names in the tooltip and the names in the legend.
  7. Repeat the last three steps on Technician Utilization (e.g. Aug 2026).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Revenue tooltip names the month and its revenue (e.g. Jul 2026, Revenue: $2,030,953).
  • The technician tooltips name the month and list every technician in the legend with that month's percent (e.g. Jun 2026: each technician's name with that month's percent, such as 129%), one entry per drawn line and nothing else.
  • A value drawn above the top of a capped chart shows its true value in the tooltip.
  • Write down whether the Revenue tooltip shows cents; the PRD does not set the tooltip's rounding, so do not fail on it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9581 (Story 9, Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 9. The tooltip contents are from the design; the PRD states only the true value on hover and the drawn lines. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 04_Revenue_Hover, 06_TechEff_Hover and 07_TechUtil_Hover.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R7: “A chart draws only the lines its own story defines: one line per selected technician on the technician charts, and one line per advisor on the Billing Efficiency chart (S9-R4). It draws no shop-average line, no aggregate line and no other reference line behind or alongside them. Any additional drawn series is a defect.”
  • S9-R7: “A chart draws only the lines its own story defines: one line per selected technician on the technician charts, and one line per advisor on the Billing Efficiency chart (S9-R4). It draws no shop-average line, no aggregate line and no other reference line behind or alongside them. Any additional drawn series is a defect.”
  • S9-R3: “A value drawn above the axis cap is clipped at the top of the chart but still shows its true value on hover.”
